meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文字版 AI 也能看懂图片,回答你关于图片的问题。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常用只能读文字的 AI 助手,又想让它看懂你发的截图和照片。
copy.tagline_en: Let your text-only AI assistant read images and answer questions about them.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often send screenshots to an AI that can't see images and wish it could.

howto.what: 当对话里出现图片文件路径/URL 或粘贴图片占位符,而 Claude 无法直接看到图片时,它会运行 modlens 把图片转成结构化 JSON 证据(文字、版面、语义、视觉线索),再据此回答,不会自行 OCR。
howto.when: 当用户给出带图片扩展名的路径或 URL(如 .png、.jpg 等)、粘贴图片占位符,而模型看不到图片内容时;也用于用户询问安装、配置或切换 modlens 服务商时。

say.text: 我贴了张图片,帮我看上面写了什么。
用 modlens 读一下我刚发的图片链接,并介绍内容。
say.note: 会转写图中文字并给出版面与语义信息。

say.text: 把 modlens 的接口换成 OpenAI 兼容服务商。
say.note: 会进入 modlens 的配置流程。

howto.what_en: Claude uses modlens to turn an image it can't see into structured JSON evidence: transcribed words, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. It answers from that JSON instead of doing its own OCR. Also helps configure providers.
howto.when_en: Runs when a path/URL with an image extension or a pasted-image placeholder appears and the model can't see the image. Also runs when the user asks to install, configure, or switch modlens providers.

say_en.text: What does the image I just pasted say?
say_en.note: Claude converts it to JSON evidence and answers from that.

say_en.text: Use modlens to read the image link I sent and tell me about it.
say_en.note: It transcribes the text and reports layout/semantics.

say_en.text: Switch modlens to an OpenAI-compatible provider.
say_en.note: Claude opens the provider config flow.
